terminal: Termio-owned Terminal (src/terminal/Terminal.zig)
|
|-- Geometry: rows / cols / pixel size / scrolling_region / tabstops
|-- Protocol/session state: modes / cursor / colors / title / pwd
|   `-- -> Surface input encoding reads negotiated state
`-- screens: ScreenSet (src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig)
    |-- active_key + active: reference into all, not another Screen
    |-- generations: distinguish removed/replaced screen storage
    `-- all: owned Screens; primary eager, alternate lazy
        `-- Each Screen (src/terminal/Screen.zig)
            |-- cursor: position/style + references into pages
            |   `-- page_pin / page_row / page_cell -> PageList storage
            |-- saved_cursor / selection / charset / kitty_keyboard
            |-- kitty_images / semantic_prompt / dirty
            `-- pages: owned PageList (src/terminal/PageList.zig)
                |-- pool: page / node / pin allocation pools
                |-- pages: ordered linked list, history -> active screen
                |   `-- Node: ownership tag + serial + page representation
                |       |-- resident: Page (src/terminal/page.zig)
                |       |   |-- Backing memory: row + cell storage
                |       |   |   `-- Row offsets locate column-ordered cells
                |       |   |-- Styles + grapheme storage/map
                |       |   `-- String allocator + hyperlink map/set
                |       `-- compressed: encoded page + retained virtual mapping
                |           `-- page() restores resident storage on demand
                |-- tracked_pins: maintained locations across page changes
                |   `-- Viewport / cursor / selection pins refer into pages
                |-- viewport + viewport_pin: view over same page list
                `-- Dimensions / scrollback limits / compression progress
